name: Dutch Financial Evaluation Benchmark
description: A benchmark designed to evaluate the performance of models on various Dutch financial tasks, introduced alongside FinGEITje, the first Dutch financial large language model. It includes an automated evaluation method using an LLM as an independent evaluator to reduce manual intervention.
reputation: A newly introduced benchmark for Dutch financial NLP that is still early in adoption but important for Dutch-language finance evaluation.
notes: Includes a specialized Dutch financial instruction tuning dataset with over 140,000 samples and an automated evaluation method using an LLM.
